note: Step A / Golden Path: visit and test cards (including cards from a doctor's instruction), rules G0 and G1, caregiver copy when consented, button replies update cards and free text opens a handover, tasks for people. v1.1: the Use Case 2T v1.4 test cycle (test reminder, report check with three buttons, upload request and nudge, outside-report score and routing in Shadow, the doctor's report review). v1.2: Voice Triage MVP-lite: a health message brings the acknowledgement and an automated call (10 questions in the patient's language: Tamil, Hindi or Telugu); Red, Amber or Green by plain rules. v1.3: Savitri Patil speaks Hindi and Nirmala Reddy Telugu; Lakshmi V. stays Tamil; voice notes HI-04 and TE-01.

ai.note: UC2a names Sarvam-30B; Sarvam deprecated it (API answer, 17 Oct 2026) and points to sarvam-105b.
